title: Cathedral of Tiny Disasters
subtitle: A component DAG performs math, physics, 3D, music and video without becoming useful enough to attract procurement.
learning: A Component DAG can stay readable while many replaceable capabilities collaborate in one artistic artifact.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.detail: Readable behavior and consent boundaries remain the product authority.

nodes.label: Math field
nodes.detail: A harmonic field owns color and particle attraction.

nodes.label: 3D reliquary
nodes.detail: Projection realizes a rotating geometric centerpiece.

nodes.label: Music Flavor
nodes.detail: Optional Web Audio maps field values into a scale.

nodes.label: Video evidence
nodes.detail: Optional capture observes the composed canvas.

nodes.label: Acceptance
nodes.detail: Offline, silent defaults and explicit media consent remain independently testable.
